FROM TRYING TO TEACHING

Ready when your classroom is.

01 / EXPLORE

Try before you unlock.

Open either level and explore its trial. There is no countdown and no sign-in.

02 / ACTIVATE

Enter the right code.

A Primary code unlocks Primary. A Secondary code unlocks Secondary. Activate either or both.

03 / COME BACK

Your browser remembers.

Choose to save access on your own device. Your valid code restores Full when you return.
